Rules.Name: Wrathmaker world rules
Rules.Hint: World-level Wrathmaker settings for crafting materials, tiers, enhanced flanking, and Hexploration.

Menu.Title: Wrathmaker Rules
Menu.Name: Wrathmaker rules
Menu.Label: Open Control Panel
Menu.Hint: Open the in-game control panel for crafting materials, tier progression, enhanced flanking, and Hexploration.

Dashboard.Heading: Wrathmaker Game Settings
Dashboard.Intro: These settings apply to the whole world and can be changed by a GM while the game is running.
Dashboard.CraftingHint: Show Material and Tier on supported item sheets and apply their names, prices, rarities, and bonuses.
Dashboard.FlankingHint: Add Wrathmaker's extra penalty at three and four qualifying sides. PF2e still handles ordinary two-sided flanking.
Dashboard.HexplorationHint: Add the party-sheet travel planner for shared Speed, vehicles, haulers, and daily activities.
Dashboard.FlankingOptionsHint: The three- and four-side values are the final AC totals after PF2e's normal -2 Off-guard penalty.
Dashboard.OversizedCount: Flankers required per side when oversized
Dashboard.MaterialsHint: Open a material to rename it, enable or disable it, and edit all six tiers.

Material.Title: Edit Crafting Material
Material.Heading: Edit Material
Material.Intro: Each tier can have its own crafted name, bonus, added price, and Pathfinder rarity.
Material.Name: Material name
Material.EnabledHint: Disabled materials no longer appear as choices on item sheets.

Reset.Title: Restore Default Wrathmaker Rules
Reset.Confirm: Replace the current material, tier, and flanking rules with the module defaults? Item flags will not be removed.

Notifications.UpdateFailed: The crafting material could not be saved.

Hexploration.Heading: Overland Travel Planner
Hexploration.Intro: Choose how the party is travelling. Wrathmaker applies one shared overland Speed without changing anyone's combat Speed.
Hexploration.SlowTravel: At this Speed, one Hexploration activity takes 2 days.
Hexploration.CustomVehicle: Custom cart, carriage, wagon, or vehicle
Hexploration.NoHaulers: No visible creatures with a ground Speed are available.
Hexploration.NoMembers: Add members to the PF2e party before planning travel.
Hexploration.DailyActivitiesHint: Plan up to the number allowed by the shared Speed. Notes can identify the character performing an individual activity.
Hexploration.Saved: The party's Hexploration travel plan was saved.
Hexploration.Announced: The Hexploration day was posted to chat.
Hexploration.NotEditable: You do not have permission to change this party's travel plan.
Hexploration.InvalidPlan: Complete the highlighted travel requirements and stay within the daily activity allowance before saving.

Warnings.vehicle-required: Select a vehicle for this travel mode.
Warnings.vehicle-speed-required: The selected vehicle has no readable Speed; enter a Speed limit manually.
Warnings.hauler-required: Select at least one creature to pull this vehicle.
Warnings.hauler-speed-required: The selected pulling creature needs a ground Speed greater than 0.
Warnings.members-required: The PF2e party has no members.
Warnings.activity-limit: The planned activities exceed the allowance for this shared Speed.
